music.prefix: Cinematic minimal instrumental score for a calm, premium product film about trust and proof. Felt piano, soft glass marimba, warm analog pads, a round synth bass, very light brushed percussion. About 88 BPM, in A minor resolving to C major. Calm, precise, quietly confident; never ominous, never epic, never hacker-movie.

parts.name: the split
styles: a soft round synth-bass pulse in eighth notes enters

parts.name: the record
styles: a steady minimal ostinato in felt piano and glass marimba
low and supportive, sits under a voice

parts.name: the proof
styles: thin out: the ostinato only, focused and exact
a brief suspended pause near the end

parts.name: the guard
styles: the pulse returns with quiet confidence

parts.name: resolve
styles: the fullest, warmest statement of the theme
settles into a clean final chord with a short natural decay
